title: Capitalization credit processed [beta]
description: This event occurs when a capitalization credit (or debit for reversals) is successfully processed. This event includes a required `external_account_id` field.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Credit or debit amount, the value is always positive.

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: Custom account ID used to identify the account within your organization. This value links the Pismo account to your internal account identifier. This field is a key that links a Pismo account to your account ID.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Operation type, either `CREDIT` for capitalization or `DEBIT` for reversal.

status.title: Status
status.description: For this event, the status is always `PROCESSED`.

error_message.title: Error message
error_message.description: Detailed error message if the capitalization processing fails.

interest_credits.title: Interest credits
interest_credits.description: Interest credit instructions related to this capitalization. Contains one element, or N+1 marginal slices when N tax thresholds are crossed.

tracking_id.title: Tracking ID
tracking_id.description: Generated tracking ID for the interest credit transaction.

payout.title: Payout
payout.description: Payout instruction related to this capitalization.

debit_tracking_id.title: Debit tracking ID
debit_tracking_id.description: Tracking ID of the debit leg of the payout.

payout_credit_tracking_id.title: Payout credit tracking ID
payout_credit_tracking_id.description: Tracking ID of the credit leg of the payout.

type.title: Informs whether the account is internal (Pismo) or external (client's account). Value is either `INTERNAL` or `EXTERNAL`

external_account.title: External account
external_account.description: Use this field to provide the external account information configured during product attachment as key-value pairs. Pismo does not evaluate this content. Required when type is EXTERNAL

internal_account_id.title: Internal account ID
internal_account_id.description: Use this field to provide the internal account ID configured during product attachment. This field is required when `type` is `INTERNAL`
